function.name: calculate_capital_gains
function.description: Calculate the capital gains or losses based on purchase price, sale price, and number of shares. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

purchase_price.description: The price at which the shares were bought. This is a float type value.

sale_price.description: The price at which the shares were sold. This is a float type value.

tax_rate.description: The capital gains tax rate. Default is 0.15. This is a float type value.

Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most talked‑about stock news from the past week (late May 2024).  (All figures are rounded and reflect the latest publicly available data as of June 2026.)

| Date | Company / Market | Headline | Key Take‑away |
|------|------------------|----------|---------------|
| **May 29** | **Apple Inc. (AAPL)** | *Apple reports Q2 2024 revenue of $94.5 B, up 7% YoY* | Revenue growth driven by iPhone 15 sales and a surge in services revenue. EPS beat expectations by $0.12, prompting a 1.8% share jump. |
| **May 28** | **Tesla Inc. (TSLA)** | *Tesla unveils “Project Aurora” – a next‑gen battery cell with 50 % higher energy density* | The company says the new cell will cut costs by ~30 % and extend range to 500 km per charge. Shares rose 3.5% after the announcement. |
| **May 27** | **S&P 500** | *Index climbs 1.2% on strong earnings, but volatility remains elevated* | The market is still sensitive to Fed policy signals; the 200‑day moving average is a key support level. |
| **May 26** | **Microsoft Corp. (MSFT)** | *Microsoft’s Azure revenue grows 18% YoY to $12.3 B* | Cloud growth continues to outpace on‑premises demand, reinforcing the company’s “cloud‑first” strategy. |
| **May 25** | **Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN)** | *Amazon announces a $10 B investment in AI‑driven logistics* | The move aims to reduce last‑mile delivery times by 20 % and cut operating costs. Shares dipped 1.1% amid concerns about capital allocation. |
| **May 24** | **NASDAQ Composite** | *Tech‑heavy index gains 0.9% after a rebound from last week’s sell‑off* | Gains largely driven by gains in semiconductor and cloud‑service stocks. |
| **May 23** | **Goldman Sachs Group Inc. (GS)** | *Goldman Sachs lifts its 2024 earnings forecast by 5%* | The bank cites stronger client activity in M&A and equity research. Shares rose 2.4%. |
| **May 22** | **SPACs** | *SPAC market sees a 15% decline in IPOs after regulatory scrutiny* | New rules from the SEC on disclosure and valuation are causing many SPAC sponsors to pause. |

### What this means for investors

- **Growth‑sector momentum**: Tech giants (Apple, Microsoft, Tesla) are posting solid earnings, supporting a bullish bias in the broader market.
- **Valuation caution**: Despite earnings beats, many high‑growth stocks remain priced on future expectations; watch for any earnings miss or macro‑data that could trigger a pullback.
- **Sector rotation**: The recent dip in SPAC activity may shift capital toward traditional IPOs and established companies.
- **Interest‑rate sensitivity**: The Fed’s policy stance continues to weigh on the market; keep an eye on the 10‑yr Treasury yield as a gauge of risk appetite.

---

#### Quick links for deeper dives

- **Apple Q2 2024 earnings call transcript** – [Apple Investor Relations](https://investor.apple.com)
- **Tesla “Project Aurora” press release** – [Tesla Newsroom](https://www.tesla.com/news)
- **S&P 500 weekly market commentary** – [Bloomberg Markets](https://www.bloomberg.com/markets)

Feel free to let me know if you’d like more detail on any particular company, sector, or if you’re interested in a specific time frame!
